criteria.text: A broker can create a new client with name, ID number, and contact details, and the client is persisted.
A broker can generate a quote for a motor product against an existing client and see a premium.
A broker can bind a quote into an active policy, and the policy status shows as active.
A broker can capture a mid-term amendment that changes the sum insured, and the premium recalculates.
A broker can lodge a claim against an active policy, and the claim appears with a reference number.
When a facultative reinsurance percentage is entered, the value is saved and reflected on the policy, not silently dropped.
